visual_action: The video opens with a clip of the musician Pitbull on stage under blue lighting, speaking into a microphone. It then cuts to a montage of clips featuring Donald Trump: walking on the White House lawn pointing at the camera, smiling while wearing a red hat that says "TRUMP WAS RIGHT ABOUT EVERYTHING!", dancing on stage at a rally at sunset while wearing a red "USA" hat, and pumping his fists. The video concludes with a black and white title card showing the White House logo and the words "THE WHITE HOUSE".

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The second half of the video is a montage of clips showing Donald Trump at various events.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and ends with a logo that reads 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

on_screen_text.text: You’ll see how much you appreciate the USA 🔥☄️

spoken_summary: In what sounds like a live concert, the musician Pitbull delivers an aggressive, profanity-laced patriotic speech. He says, "Who the f**k doesn't like the United States of America... f**k you at the same time." He tells those who don't like the country to "go back to the countries that we the f**k are from, and you'll see how much you appreciate the United States of America." He then yells "Fireball," cuing his song.
audio_music: The video begins with dialogue from a live performance. At the 19-second mark, after the speaker yells "Fireball," the upbeat, high-energy pop song "Fireball" by Pitbull begins and plays through the rest of the video, creating a celebratory and hype-filled mood for the montage of Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a single clip and then transitions into a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of Donald Trump, synchronized with the start of an upbeat song.
central_claim: Donald Trump embodies the aggressive American patriotism expressed in Pitbull's speech.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of national pride and rally support for Donald Trump by portraying him as a strong, celebratory, and patriotic figure.
